pages.text: A COMMENT block holds a note for humans.$(br2)Put it at the end of a line. The cursor ignores the COMMENT and every block after it. So a COMMENT in front of blocks switches them off.
A line that starts with a COMMENT is a comment line. It is skipped like a NOOP line. Right-click the block with an empty hand to write its text.
Put a glass block in the middle and eight NOOP blocks around it. You get eight COMMENT blocks.
The text notation writes a COMMENT block as $(1)//$() followed by its text.
$(1)// A comment line is skipped completely$(br)VARIABLE time INTEGER 1 // a comment at the end$()
